messages:
incident-bot: Pager: ORBIT-EU-WEST dedicated pool p99 latency spike detected (>3s) for tenant orbit_fin. Auto-escalation to Sev2. Links: https://obs.redwood/alerts/ORBIT-1977654321 :rotating_light:

sara.ops: I'm on it. Pulling logs and pool state now. @eli-sre can you grab model shard KPIs?

eli-sre: On deck. Seeing p95 ~1.2s but p99 jumping to 4.1s on eu-west1-dedicated-3. KV cache miss rate is high for orbit_fin prefixes (miss ~72%). Possible cache thrash.

matt.platform: Noted. Dedicated pool dedicated-3 shows increased GPU QPS and several workers reporting OOM-retries in last 10m. Could be a batch-size regression from yesterday's deploy.

sara.ops: Rolling back last config change to routing policy (deployed 02:13 UTC). Command: `/deploy rollback routing/orbit-policy 2026-03-08T02:13Z`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for routing/orbit-policy by sara.ops. Canary abort + rollback to v2a. ETA ~90s.

customer-eng: Orbit account rep on the call. They're seeing production timeouts in EU for several dashboards. Asking for ETA and mitigation plan.

eli-sre: While rollback completes, suggest immediate mitigation: 1) Evict orbit_fin from dedicated-3 to dedicated-4 (less loaded) 2) Enable hosted fallback routing for orbit_fin (latency/quality tradeoff) 3) Increase KV cache TTL for orbit prefixes to reduce miss storm.

matt.platform: Initiating evict: `./admin move-tenant --tenant orbit_fin --from dedicated-3 --to dedicated-4 --mode drain`

incident-bot: Eviction job 8731 queued. Progress: 0/12 shards moved.

sara.ops: Enabling hosted fallback for orbit_fin: `rbctl routing set-orbit-fallback --tenant orbit_fin --target hosted-lowcost --weight 25`

matt.platform: Eviction 8731 progress: 6/12 shards moved. Some shards slow due to KV write locks. Increasing concurrency for shard-mover to 8.

eli-sre: Meanwhile observed model-level hotspot: shard s-07 serving heavy long-context prompts causing KV cache thrash; recommended to enable shard-level rate limit of 120 QPS for orbit_fin until stable. `shardctl limit set s-07 120 --tenant orbit_fin`

oncall-liaison: Handoff note for morning oncall (08:00 UTC): orbit_fin is currently on degraded path (25% traffic to hosted fallback). Eviction nearing completion. Customer notified of mitigation.

customer-eng: Orbit acknowledged workaround. They want a temporary SLA credit and want a runbook for tenant burst isolation. Asking for ETA on full remediation.

eli-sre: Short-term ETA: 30-45m to finish shard moves and stabilize cache TTL. Medium-term: we'll run a light recompile of kernels on dedicated-4 to reduce OOMs and audit recent routing rule change for regression.

sara.ops: Rollback complete. Routing policy reverted to v2a. Eviction job complete: 12/12 shards moved. p99 dropped to ~1.1s for orbit_fin, KV miss rate down to 18%.

matt.platform: Hosted fallback traffic now at 0% (rolled back) — moved back to dedicated-4 fully. Monitoring for 30m.

incident-bot: Alert resolved (ORBIT-EU-WEST). Please tag with postmortem when available: `#postmortems` and create incident runbook entry.

sara.ops: Agree. Creating quick postmortem ticket: PMT-5982. Owner: eli-sre. Action items: 1) Add tenant isolation checklist for heavy prefix workloads 2) Improve shard mover concurrency controls and better backpressure signals 3) Add KV cache TTL auto-suggests to Optimize UI.

eli-sre: Will draft postmortem and runbook. Adding notes: suspect root cause = routing policy change that altered batching/concurrency for this tenant, exposing long-context prompts that exhausted cache and caused OOM retry cascade.

customer-eng: Orbit asked us to share scope of customers impacted (only orbit_fin in dedicated-3). Confirmed. They're okay with PMT-5982 owner and timeline. :white_check_mark:

sara.ops: Closing war room after 30m stable window. If we see >=2 regressions, reopen. Thanks all. :coffee:
